description:
Same as `top_devices_by_uptime`, but restricted to devices that have not
yet rebooted past their recorded maximum — meaning the uptime is currently
still climbing. These are the devices that are 'live' champions right now,
as opposed to historical record-holders. Each entry includes a `url`
pointing at the device's interactive battery history page on
https://www.battery-snap.com.

brand.description: Optional lowercase brand filter. When omitted, devices from any brand are ranked together.

model.description: Optional model filter — matches resolved street name or raw Build.MODEL, case-insensitive. When omitted, no model filter applies.

name: top_devices_by_live_uptime

is_live.description: True when the device has not yet rebooted past this max — the uptime is still climbing live.

max_uptime_hours.description: Same value as max_uptime_seconds, in hours.

max_uptime_seconds.description: Longest single uptime ever recorded between reboots, in seconds.

model.description: Resolved model name (street name), e.g. 'Galaxy S23'.

raw_model.description: Raw Build.MODEL identifier reported by the device.

url.description: Public BatterySnap web page showing this device's interactive battery history, e.g. https://www.battery-snap.com/device_history?device=<uid>. Locale-agnostic.

title: Top devices by live uptime
